preview.text:
AI coding agents can waste time and tokens relearning the same lessons. TokenEconomizer builds on past sessions to cut costs while maintaining task success. It’s a path toward coding agents that learn not only how to solve tasks, but also how to spend computation more effectively. 

The open-source plugin is available now on @github.
